description: Reviewed decisions for the monotonic Modern Greek word list (export_el_monotonic.py) that its rules cannot make. A form under rejects never enters the list, whichever route admits it. A form under corpus_accepts is a corpus word that the variant-spelling or typing-slip rules of the corpus route would refuse because a far commoner word shares its letters or its sound, or is one typing slip away; it still needs the corpus evidence of that route. A form under elision_accepts is an elision whose letters without the mark are also a word, which the elision rule otherwise refuses (εξ’, εν’ and εκ’ are misspellings, since εκ, εξ and εν do not elide); it still needs the corpus evidence of the elision route. An abbreviation or acronym under the matching rejects never enters its companion list. Each entry says why. The exporter records the sha256 of this file in el_monotonic.version.

rejects.reason: κι is already the shortened form of και and takes no elision mark in standard spelling (κι αν, κι εγώ).
An old spelling of ’χει (να ’χη), from the Katharevousa subjunctive έχη.
γι’ αυτό written as one word.
κανά δυο written as one word.
A misspelling of συνέβη; the variant rule keeps it because -ει after the stem of a noun in -η is a Katharevousa dative (εν γνώσει).
A misspelling of πάση (πάση θυσία); kept by the variant rule for the same reason as συνέβει.

The letter iota, not a word; Wiktionary has it as a letter entry and enumerations (ι) supply its counts. As a rated entry it would accept a slip for ο (the next key) or a misspelling of the article η uncorrected.
The letter upsilon, not a word; Wiktionary has it as a letter entry and enumerations (υ) supply its counts. As a rated entry it would accept a slip for τ or θ uncorrected.

An abbreviation of κύριε written without its period (the abbreviation list has κ.). As an entry, rated C on subtitle counts, it accepted κε, the commonest misspelling of και, uncorrected: in the typing-slip simulation of eval/eval_el_accent_restoration.py --quick it was the most frequent slip that lands on an entry (137 of 6,204 slipped words).

The colloquial ήτον beside ήταν, not a slip of τον.
From αναμασώ (rehash), not a slip of ανάμεσα.
The colloquial βγάνω beside βγάζω, not a slip of βγαίνει.
From βορεινός (northern), not a slip of βόρεια.
From γόης (charmer), not a slip of γη.
The colloquial pronoun δαύτος, not a slip of αυτόν.
Deuterium, not a slip of δεύτερο.
The colloquial second person είπας beside είπες, not a slip of είπα.
The emphatic pronoun εμέ beside εμένα, not a slip of με.
From ενάντιος (opposed), not a slip of εναντίον.
From επαιτώ (beg), not a slip of απαιτεί.
The set phrases καλήν εσπέρα and καλήν αντάμωση, not a slip of καλή.
From κότινος (olive wreath), not a slip of κοινό.
The loanword μάκρο (macro), not a slip of μικρό.
From μαίνομαι (rage), not a slip of φαίνεται.
From νοώ (mean, understand), not a slip of νέοι.
The accusative πολύν in πολύν καιρό, standard Modern Greek, not a slip of πολύ.
The conjunction πρωτού (before), a word in its own right, not a misplaced accent of πρώτου.
Propolis, not a slip of προβολή.
The loanword πόρταλ (portal), not a slip of πόρτα.
From συνέχω (hold together), not a slip of συνέχεια.
The accusative τέτοιαν before a vowel, like μιαν and καμιάν, not a slip of τέτοια.
Tritium, not a slip of τρίτο.
